items.title: 30.7.3 13C NMR se molecule ki banawat maloom karna (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of determining structure from 13C NMR (PDF 213-214).

items: Peaks ginein: peaks ki tadaad carbon environments ki tadaad hai. 5 carbon atoms lekin sirf 3 peaks wale molecule mein chemically equivalent carbons ke 2 jore hone chahiye.
Har peak ki jagah (chemical shift) dekh kar batayein ke carbon alkane, alkene, alkyne, aromatic ya carbonyl environment mein hai (Table 30.3).
Peaks ki maloomat aur molecular formula dono se milne wali mumkin banawatein nikalein.

blocks.text: Kitab ki misal: compound C4H10O ka 13C spectrum 3 peaks deta hai, 69.0, 30.5 aur 19.0 ppm par (Figure 30.8), is liye teen carbon environments hain. Butan-1-ol aur butan-2-ol dono ke chaar mukhtalif carbons hain aur chaar peaks dikhate, is liye dono fit nahi hote. Kitab nateeja nikalti hai ke compound 2-methoxypropane hai, jis ke teen carbon environments hain.

blocks.alt: 13C NMR spectrum: INTENSITY banam C-13 NMR chemical shift ppm, 200 se 0. Teen lakeerein: b 69.0, c 30.5 aur a 19.0 (sab se lambi), aur 0 par gulabi TMS lakeer.
blocks.caption: Figure 30.8: Aik na-maloom molecule ka 13C NMR spectrum (kitab ki Figure 30.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teen lakeerein = teen carbon environments; a (19.0) sab se lambi hai. 69.0 ppm wala carbon oxygen se jura hai (Table 30.3: C-O 50-70 ppm). Neeche 'Kitab ki ghalti' box parhein: yeh shifts 2-methylpropan-1-ol se milti hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab nateeja nikalti hai ke compound 2-methoxypropane hai, lekin shifts us se nahi miltin. 2-methoxypropane, CH3-O-CH(CH3)2, oxygen se jure do carbons ki peaks (taqreeban 56 aur 72 ppm) aur aik taqreeban 22 ppm par dikhata, jabke chhape spectrum mein 50 ppm se oopar sirf aik peak aur aik 30.5 ppm par hai. Shifts 69.0, 30.5 aur 19.0 ppm 2-methylpropan-1-ol, (CH3)2CH-CH2-OH, se milti hain, jis ke bhi teen carbon environments hain; yahi sahi jawab hai.

blocks.prompt: Figure 30.8 se samjhayein ke spectrum butan-1-ol ya butan-2-ol se kyun nahi milta.
blocks.explanation: CH3CH2CH2CH2OH aur CH3CH(OH)CH2CH3 dono ke chaar mukhtalif carbon environments hain aur chaar peaks dete; spectrum mein sirf teen hain.

blocks.prompt: Butan-1-ol aur butan-2-ol ke spectra mein kaun si peaks mutawaqqa hain?
blocks.explanation: Butan-1-ol: CH2-O carbon 50-70 ppm (taqreeban 62) aur teen alkyl carbons 0-50 ppm (taqreeban 35, 19 aur 14). Butan-2-ol: CH-O carbon 50-70 ppm (taqreeban 69) aur teen alkyl carbons (taqreeban 32, 23 aur 10).

items: Peaks ginein (environments), shifts parhein (Table 30.3), formula se milayein.
3 peaks wala C4H10O: butan-1-ol ya butan-2-ol nahi (har aik ki 4 peaks).
